posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get listed on LobeHub (DR 75). You get a dedicated page and a dofollow link.

Here is how:

1. Put your MCP server in a public GitHub repo with a detailed README (ask Claude to do it for you). LobeHub builds your page from it.
2. Install the CLI with npm i -g @ lobehub/market-cli, then run lhm login and lhm github connect.
3. Add an lhm.plugin.json with a name, version and your MCP URL, then run lhm plugin publish.

A few notes:

Every link in your README shows up on the page, and they're all dofollow. Link your homepage and signup page.
posts.author: Taras
posts.notes: 在 LobeHub 上通过 CLI 发布 MCP server plugin，得到 DR75 的 dofollow 专页外链。

comments.author: Fanfulla
comments.content: Stuffing the README with signup links feels spammy to me, the page should sell the tools first and the links come after

posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get listed on Vercel's https://www.skills.sh/ (DR 82). You get a dedicated page with your skill, its install command and an install counter.

Here is how:

1. Write an agent skill for your SaaS, a SKILL.md that tells the agent how to use your API (ask Claude to do it for you).
2. Put it in a public GitHub repo.
3. Run npx skills add your-org/your-repo once.
posts.author: Taras
posts.notes: 在 Vercel skills.sh 上添加 agent skill，得到 DR82 的专页（带安装计数）。

comments.author: Tushar Kapil
comments.content: It’s a no follow link though
